notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for preserving a queued timestamped ordinary attribute update for each constrained recipient after its source resigns. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies per-recipient reflection and grant ordering, value and timestamp metadata, and terminal retraction behavior without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped UpdateAttributeValues, unconditional-divest resignation, retraction, and FederateAmbassador discovery, reflection, time-role, and grant callbacks for multiple recipients
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped attribute, resignation, retraction, and time-management declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
